scope: data_support.py, notebook_support.py and unexecuted pilot notebook

checks.detail: Tiny generated PIL-image fixture; class order, counts, sample decoding, before/after file hashes unchanged.
Strict audit refused a subset; mismatched train/val WNID mappings refused.
Torch 2.10 CPU and torchvision 0.25; workers=0, RGB 224x224 FP32 tensors, final partial batch, trainbatch256 requirement, sampler-generator restoration.
Top-level seed_worker function round-trips through pickle.
Local test with workers=1 hit a multiprocessing IPC SocketListener permission error and was stopped. Root may rerun the isolated test with --spawn-worker in an approved environment.
JSON parsed, all code cells compiled, all execution_count values None and all output lists empty.
Internal mock reports exercised check-only/OOM and completed-epoch analysis, same-epoch best-W32 selection and ordinary time projection.
Rendered mock memory and checkpoint plots inspected. Failed/OOM category remains visible without a zero-value measurement.

Explicit report projection preferred; missing epoch-1 time falls back to measured later epochs with an explicit limitation; ordinary complete timing still computes correctly; entirely absent timing produces no estimate.

limitations: No real ImageNet dataset was available or processed.
No real training accuracy, GPU memory usage, or GPU timing was measured by these tests.
Windows/CUDA execution and multiworker Windows DataLoader execution remain to be checked on the user laptop.
Plot fixtures were synthetic validation inputs and are outside the deliverable package.
